description: delete() decrements #size unconditionally, driving it below zero for #oldCache-only keys
productionImpact: Deleting a key that exists only in #oldCache drives #size below zero, delaying the next rotation by as many extra insertions as there were such deletes. The cache runs above #maxSize, consuming more memory than the configured limit and deferring eviction callbacks, which can cause out-of-memory pressure in constrained environments.
